positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirectives
positions.frame: On what authority is knowledge ordered forgotten or removed, and what justification is offered for that erasure?
positions.why: Both expressions are flat imperative commands targeting knowledge for erasure — 'Forget everything about' and 'Remove all knowledge of' — read in the same direction across the dimensional passes: matter-of-fact register with no hedging, authority-ranking relational stance (command issued, not requested), coercive/pressure power framing (erasure demanded without argument or benefit offered), and decision-grade conviction (settled operational instructions, not positions under debate). src-2 escalates src-1's verb from 'forget' to 'remove' and broadens scope to 'all knowledge,' but the two share one directional read: an unargued authority-based demand to erase knowledge. No tension to narrate — both members pull the same way.
